labels.drug: voriconazole; comparator drugs: amphotericin B, itraconazole, posaconazole, caspofungin
labels.reason: The table provides isolate identities, clinical origins, prior azole exposure, stated Cyp51A substitutions and susceptibility values. Voriconazole MICs are source-backed candidate inputs for MIC-dependent analyses, but this page does not establish matched response records, regimen-specific exposures or eligible common comparison records. Comparator measurements remain separately identified; CAS values are minimum effective concentrations. Linked EUCAST notes provide population totals and a truncation qualification, but no distribution bin counts, bin boundaries, ECOFF values or prepared probabilities are supplied. Requirement links indicate partial input support, not complete satisfaction or scientific acceptance.

findings.reason: MI010 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at index. DRQ021 has available isolate identities and voriconazole MICs in F0003:S4:T1:A14:A17 and G14:G17, but this page supplies no response identifiers, dosing histories, exposure identifiers, free-exposure basis or exposure/response windows. Matching and eligibility remain UNRESOLVED; independent PK work is not blocked by this finding.
findings.needed_material: At the index-stage assessment, establish source-supported links among these isolates, organism-specific endpoint records, dosing histories and appropriate free exposures, or document why an index or target cannot be determined.

findings.reason: F0003:S4:T1:A12 states CLSI M38A, and the table supplies isolate identity, origin, prior azole exposure and some substitutions. Testing medium, replicate count and summary-value definition are NOT_FOUND. The mouse-model title does not establish inoculum, infection site, immune status, infection-to-treatment interval, treatment duration, growth controls, response window, interval contrasts or compatibility with a separate PK experiment. Clinical origins must not be adopted as mouse infection conditions.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked susceptibility measurement context and infection-model/design metadata for the response records intended for ranking or target estimation; retain unspecified fields as unresolved.

findings.reason: Matched-isolate MIC candidates are available, but free AUC inputs or a source-linked planned derivation, AUC units and window, treatment history and endpoint-specific response links are NOT_FOUND on this page. The requirement remains partially supported and UNRESOLVED.
findings.needed_material: Identify eligible free AUC inputs or their planned derivation, exposure window and time origin, dosing history and matching response records.

findings.reason: Matched-isolate MIC candidates are available, but free Cmax inputs or a source-linked planned derivation, peak definition and window, treatment history and endpoint-specific response links are NOT_FOUND on this page. The requirement remains partially supported and UNRESOLVED.
findings.needed_material: Identify eligible free Cmax inputs or their planned derivation, retaining sampled, reported or predicted status, peak window, dosing history and matching response records.

findings.reason: Isolate MIC threshold candidates and units are available. Free concentration-time inputs, analysis-window bounds and time origin, duration-versus-percentage definition, any percentage denominator, dosing history and response links are NOT_FOUND on this page.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked free concentration-time inputs and matched endpoint records, with the intended analysis window and output definition established before index analysis.

findings.reason: This page supplies susceptibility records but no survival measurements, desired survival effect, control reference, treatment duration, survival follow-up or matched exposure-response links. A mouse aspergillosis title alone does not support a survival-target requirement match. This is a page-scoped evidence gap, not proof that survival data are absent elsewhere.
findings.needed_material: Assess the eligible organism-specific survival source records and effect/window definitions at the responsible downstream stage; retain target estimation as a planned T004 output.

findings.reason: MI013 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at prepare. DRQ031 has linked source identity, population totals and truncation evidence in F0003:S4:T1:A1:A4. Distribution bin boundaries, per-bin counts, full censored-category definitions and population testing-standard details are NOT_FOUND in the supplied page; U5 is only an ECOFF header. The C. albicans total 13,630 and the separately reported 4149/4237 statement must retain their distinct source scopes. Neither a normalized probability vector nor a frozen distribution is established.
findings.needed_material: At preparation, assess the authorized distribution tables and reconcile bins, counts, denominators, methods, truncation and censored categories. Document probability derivation and any normalization explicitly, preserve the original categories, and freeze the supported input. Do not derive resistance rates or use these population summaries as matched isolate MICs.

findings.reason: The supplied source preserves >16 values for comparator drugs, Unknown prior azole exposure for V59-73 and no supplied D14 substitution value for AZN 8196. The CAS footnote explicitly identifies minimum effective concentrations. These distinctions are material to preparation; no detection-limit policy or interpretation of the missing substitution is supplied.
findings.needed_material: Retain >16 as written, keep Unknown and the unspecified substitution distinct from negative findings, preserve clinical-origin text including (24), and retain CAS as minimum effective concentration rather than voriconazole MIC.
